within_individual_balance.state_rule: each four-trial block contains w0,w1,w2,w3 exactly once
within_individual_balance.terminal_position_rule: two trials per block with each q_left/q_right physical side assignment
within_individual_balance.fixed_order_rule: two trials per block for each state-independent terminal order
within_individual_balance.b1_fixed_rule: q_left and q_right are each used on half of B=1 fixed trials, independently of state
within_individual_balance.b3_rule: both access arms receive all three cues with identical access surface

between_individual_counterbalance.property: each cue flip is balanced and every pair of cue-flip bits realizes all four combinations within each treatment cell

sample_size.forbidden_interpretation: 4 individuals per cell or 48 total individuals is not the powered biological sample size
sample_size.freeze_rule: definitive sample size must come from nuisance-parameter simulation using procedural/full-information pilot information without using the focal confirmatory architecture-by-access effect

claim_boundary: This gate freezes allocation, randomization and counterbalancing mechanics only. It does not freeze sample size, husbandry, apparatus dimensions, training criterion, or ethical protocol.
